serveurs.intro: The servers whose configuration you can manage. Pick one to set up {nom}.
serveurs.aucun: No manageable server found on your account.

serveur.botAbsentAide: {nom} is self-hosted: everyone runs their own instance.
serveur.lectureSeule: ⚠️ Live editing is unavailable (the bot API is not configured or cannot be reached). Here are the bot's modules; come back once the API answers to configure them.
serveur.grade: You are here as: {grades}. You only see what that grade opens.

langueBot.aide: The language {nom} speaks to your members in on this server: commands, panels, announcements. It is independent from the site language.
langueBot.indisponible: This bot offers a single language.
langueBot.echec: ❌ The bot did not accept this change.

module.sansReglage: This module has no settings: the switch above is all it needs.
module.desactiveAvis: ⚠️ This module is off. You can configure it, but it will only act once turned on with the switch at the top of the page.
module.publie: ✅ Saved, and the message was posted / updated on Discord.
module.publicationEchouee: ❌ Saved, but publishing failed (missing channel or insufficient permissions?).
module.injoignable: ❌ Bot unreachable (API not configured or offline).
module.refuse: ❌ Save rejected: fix the fields below.
module.refuseSansDetail: ❌ The bot rejected the save (HTTP {statut}) without saying which field is at fault — it may be running an older version.
module.publierAide: “Save & publish” posts or updates the message (embed + buttons) directly in the configured channel — no need to go back to Discord.
module.actionsAide: One-off operations on this server. They apply to the saved configuration: remember to save first.
module.partiel: Your grade only opens part of this module: the other blocks, the switch and the action buttons are not served to you.
module.sansModifier: Your grade does not allow editing existing rows: your changes would be reverted on save.
module.lectureSeule: 🔒 Your grade opens this block read-only: you can view it, not save it.

danger.texte: Permanently erases everything the bot created for {nom} (levels, economy, tickets, suggestions, configuration…) then removes the bot from the server. This cannot be undone.
danger.confirmer: Are you sure? Everything will be deleted and the bot will leave the server.
danger.echec: Deletion failed. Try again or get in touch.
